rumors.text: Word on the street: a new ripper set up in a basement on Sublevel 3.
Doctors whisper about 'static fever': chrome-heavy patients losing time, then losing themselves.
The Undermarket moves military chrome through the old flood tunnels. Ask for Wire.
Aegis Meridian Security is paying informants who report unlicensed clinics.
Two Rustline crews are fighting over the drowned district. Expect more knife wounds.
A Lyra Biocomp prototype memory core went missing from a lab convoy last week.
Inspector Moor never refuses a 'consulting fee'. Or so people say.
A disgraced corporate surgeon is drinking her pension away in the Sump.
Some rippers plant kill-switches for the gangs. Nobody admits to it.
Up-level clinics run robot arms and neural scanners. Down here we use hands.
Lyra ran neural trials on Sump residents through 'free clinics'. The subjects were listed as volunteers. Some of them are still in the annex past Checkpoint 9.
The Spindle Interchange sees everyone sooner or later. If someone in Caldera is hiding, ask the freight handlers.
